# PT Indochain Global Makmur (PT Indochain)

> Indonesia-based trading and distribution company and sister company of New Chien Te Hang Co., Ltd. (NCTH), Taiwan. Supplies foundry and casting materials, refractory products, industrial chemicals, and Indonesian agricultural and food products.

## Foundry & casting products
- [Exothermic Powder (Exothermic Piping Compound)](https://indochain.co.id/exothermic-piping-compound.html): Exothermic powder for foundries in Indonesia. Exothermic piping compound that prevents piping defects in castings after pouring. Supplied by PT Indochain.
- [Bentobond Bentonite Binder for Green Sand](https://indochain.co.id/bentobond.html): Bentobond PLUS+ bentonite binder for green sand molding, supplied in Indonesia by PT Indochain. Comparable to natural sodium bentonite in tests.
- [Patching Material for Ladles, Runners & Furnaces](https://indochain.co.id/patching-material.html): Patching material for repairing ladles, runners and furnaces. Alumina/silica grades R90 to R80 and silica grade R66S. Supplied in Indonesia by PT Indochain.
- [Sea Coal (Coal Dust) for Green Sand](https://indochain.co.id/sea-coal.html): Sea coal (coal dust) for green sand molding to improve casting surfaces and ease demolding. Foundry supplier in Indonesia: PT Indochain.
- [Slag X Conditioner Melt Additive](https://indochain.co.id/slag-x-conditioner.html): SLAG X Conditioner, a melt additive that alters slag and purifies molten metal for better energy efficiency in electric induction melting. Supplied in Indonesia by PT Indochain.
- [Superbond+ Green Sand Additive](https://indochain.co.id/superbond-plus.html): Superbond+ green sand additive that strengthens sand, stabilizes the mold surface and lets more sand be recycled. Supplied in Indonesia by PT Indochain.
- [Automatic Green Sand Control System ETA 3000](https://indochain.co.id/automatic-green-sand-control-system.html): Automatic green sand control system (ETA 3000) for measuring and controlling compactability, green compression strength and moisture in foundry sand.
- [Automatic Molding Machine by Belloi & Romagnoli](https://indochain.co.id/automatic-molding-machine.html): Automatic molding machine from Belloi & Romagnoli, Italy, offered through New Chien Te Hang (NCTH) for the casting industry.
- [Oxygen Rotary Furnace for Foundry](https://indochain.co.id/oxygen-rotary-furnace.html): Oxygen rotary furnace for the foundry industry from SOGEMI ENGINEERING, Italy, offered through New Chien Te Hang (NCTH). Focus on energy efficiency.
- [Vibrator for Small Furnaces](https://indochain.co.id/vibrator.html): NCTH Invincible furnace vibration machine for small furnaces, with adjustable air pressure for a more stable air volume. Offered by PT Indochain.

## Agricultural & food products
- [Agricultural Products](https://indochain.co.id/agricultural-products.html): vanilla beans, cocoa, spices, konjac, lobster, and processed konjac, corn and cassava rice from Indonesia.
